title: Upgrade /login mobile number field to premium international phone input with auto-detect + per-country validation

requirements.text: Replace the existing plain phone number <Input> on the /login page with an advanced international phone input that has: (1) a left-side country selector showing flag + country name + dial code, and (2) a right-side phone number input. The dropdown must include at least 20 popular countries (including India +91, United States +1, United Kingdom +44, UAE +971) and support searching to manually change the country.

quotes: Replace current mobile number input with an advanced international phone input
Manual selection: User dropdown se country change kar sake (searchable dropdown if possible).

acceptanceCriteria: In both Sign In and Sign Up tabs on /login, the phone step shows a country dropdown (flag + country name + dial code) and a number input side-by-side, responsive to small screens.
The country dropdown is searchable and allows changing the country manually.
At least 20 countries are available in the dropdown, including India (+91), United States (+1), United Kingdom (+44), and UAE (+971).

requirements.text: Auto-detect and pre-select the user's country on /login page load using a browser-based approach (e.g., Intl / locale hints). If detection fails or produces an unsupported/unknown country, default to India (+91). The selected flag + dial code must be shown immediately without user interaction.

quotes: Auto-detect user's country code on page load
default to India +91 if detection fails

acceptanceCriteria: On first load of /login, the country selector is pre-populated automatically without user input.
If auto-detection cannot determine a supported country, the selector defaults to India (+91).
The selected flag and dial code are visible immediately on render.

requirements.text: Implement per-country phone validation triggered on blur of the phone field and on 'Send OTP' click. Validation must check that the number matches the selected country's expected length/format (e.g., India must validate as a 10-digit national number) and block OTP sending when invalid. Display an inline error message directly below the phone input group with exact text: "Please enter a valid [country] mobile number" (country name based on current selection).

quotes: On blur or Send OTP click: check number length/format for selected country (e.g., India = 10 digits).
Error message below input (pearl blue text, gold border): "Please enter a valid [country] mobile number"

acceptanceCriteria: Invalid numbers show an inline error directly below the phone input group (not only as a top-of-card alert).
Inline error uses pearl-blue text styling and a gold border treatment as specified, and uses the exact required sentence with the country name substituted.
Clicking 'Send OTP' does not proceed to the OTP step when the phone number is invalid for the selected country.
India selection validates as a 10-digit national number (with +91 country code applied in the stored/sent value).

requirements.text: Update /login page styling for the new phone input so it matches the existing dark luxury theme: black/dark backgrounds, pearl-blue (#7FB3D5) accents, and gold (#D4AF37) hover/glow on the dropdown and Send OTP button. Ensure the Send OTP button retains the existing continuous gold pulse/glow behavior and the phone input group is fully responsive (full-width on mobile, no overflow).

quotes: Dark luxury theme (black bg, pearl blue #7FB3D5 accents, gold #D4AF37 hover/glow on dropdown/button).
Golden continuous pulse/hover on "Send OTP" button.
Responsive: dropdown scales on mobile, input full-width.

acceptanceCriteria: Country dropdown and phone input visually match the app’s dark luxury theme and do not introduce mismatched light styles.
Dropdown and interactive states show gold hover/glow effects; pearl-blue is used for primary accents.
Send OTP button continues to use the continuous pulse/glow styling already used on the page.
Mobile layout stacks or compresses gracefully with no clipping/overlap; the overall control remains full-width.

requirements.text: Keep the existing OTP login flow behavior intact: Send OTP → simulated OTP alert/console → OTP input → verify → success navigates to /dashboard; lockout/attempt handling must continue to work. The stored phone number used by the OTP session must include the selected international dial code (E.164-style with leading '+').

quotes: Keep existing OTP flow (Send OTP → simulated OTP alert → input → verify).

acceptanceCriteria: The OTP step UI and verification logic continue to function as before (including attempt counting and 10-minute lockout).
The OTP session stores the full international phone number including '+' and the selected country dial code.
Changing country + number and resending OTP still transitions correctly to the OTP step when valid.

requirements.text: Add a brief internal QA checklist for this change (can be appended to frontend/RELEASE_NOTES.md for the next version) that confirms: auto-detection fallback to India works, dropdown shows flags/names/codes and manual selection works, validation is per-country, no UI/hover/animation regressions, and the OTP flow still works end-to-end.

quotes: Confirm: Country code auto-detected (default +91 India). Dropdown shows flags/names/codes, manual select works. Input validates based on selected country. No bugs in UI/hovers/animations. Login flow still works.

acceptanceCriteria: Release notes include a short checklist covering the specified confirmations for manual verification.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only shadcn components); compose new UI using existing components and custom wrappers instead.
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (immutable paths).
Maintain the single-page app routing behavior; changes must be confined to the /login experience and related supporting components/utilities.
nonGoals: Do not implement real SMS delivery or server-side OTP verification.
Do not change the backend canister (Motoko) for this request.
Do not redesign other pages or alter cart/wishlist/checkout behavior.
